text_overrides.ordinary_2: All right. Fitting armor keeps me busy.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: Doing fine. A little tired, that's all.
text_overrides.content_1: I'm in a good mood, actually.
text_overrides.content_2: Pretty good. The forge is hard work, but I like it.
text_overrides.stressed_1: A bit strained. Too much to think about.
text_overrides.stressed_2: I've got a lot on my mind.
text_overrides.stressed_3: Worn out, honestly. I could do with a rest.
